phrases.english: You are stronger than you think.
Feel your feet, on the ground.
Believe in yourself, you can do it.
Let your mind wander, then focus.
Learn a little, grow a lot.
Try again, you can do it.
I can learn, step by step.
Mistakes are okay, I am learning.
You are my best friend, always.
Hello there, nice to meet you.
I am lost. Can you help?
My love, for you, is deep.
You are doing great, keep it up.
I made a mistake, please let it go.
I regret my actions, please forgive.
phrases.transliteration: nanna krutya galige vishadissuttene, dayavittu kshamisi.

phrases.english: Listen more, speak less, understand all.
phrases.kannada: ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಕೇಳಿ, ಕಡಿಮೆ ಮಾತನಾಡಿ, ಎಲ್ಲವನ್ನೂ ಅರಿತುಕೊಳ್ಳಿ.
phrases.transliteration: hechchu keli, kamiya maatanaadi, ellavannu aritukolli.

phrases.english: Patience, my friend, brings great rewards.
Small steps forward, always win the race.
Learn from yesterday, live today, plan tomorrow.
phrases.kannada: ನಿನ್ನೆ ಕಲಿಯಿರಿ, ಇಂದು ಬಾಳಿ, ನಾಳೆ ಯೋಜಿಸಿ.
phrases.transliteration: ninne kaliyiri, indu baali, naale yojisi.

phrases.english: Kindness costs nothing, but is priceless.
Build your knowledge, word by word.
My life, is better, with you.
Forever, with you, is my wish.
My voice matters, when I speak.
I am proud, of my effort.
Truth, even if bitter, is always best.
One good deed, spreads far and wide.
Gratitude, opens many doors for you.
I hope you can forgive me.
I'll do better next time, please forgive.
phrases.kannada: ಮುಂದೆ ನಾನು ಉತ್ತಮವಾಗಿ ಮಾಡುತ್ತೇನೆ, ದಯವಿಟ್ಟು ಕ್ಷಮಿಸಿ.
phrases.transliteration: mundu naanu uttamavaagi maaduttene, dayavittu kshamisi.

phrases.english: What a joy, such a joy!
My heart is full, so full.
Can you show me the way?
I need to find a safe place.
Where is the bus stop, please?
I need a ticket, to Mysore.
How much is this, for one person?
I want to go, to the hotel.
It will happen, when it's time.
This is the color, I want.
Imagine new worlds, draw them out.
Your ideas, let them flow freely.
Build with passion, see it grow.
I can do this, I will try.
Learning is fun, don't give up.
Mistakes are okay, learn from them.
Mistakes are lessons, learn from them.
Thanks for being there, for me.

phrases.transliteration: Tūka vanna badalāyisi, nim'ma nelaiyannu huḍuki.

phrases.english: Hello, where is the train station?
I want to go to the airport.
Slow and steady, wins the race.
phrases.transliteration: Nidhaana, aadhare khachithavaagi, geluvu nimma dhey.

phrases.english: Wait a little, it will be fine.
My heart, is full of joy.
One day at a time, you'll get there.

phrases.transliteration: Dhair yavāgi nāvīnyagoḷisi, hosa dārigalannu anvēṣisi.

phrases.english: Express yourself, through art and words.
phrases.kannada: ಕಲೆ ಮತ್ತು ಪದಗಳ ಮೂಲಕ, ನಿಮ್ಮನ್ನು ವ್ಯಕ್ತಪಡಿಸಿ.
phrases.transliteration: Kale mattu padagaḷa mūlaka, nim'mannu vyaktapaḍisi.

phrases.english: Let inspiration strike, capture the moment.
Dream big, then make it real.
phrases.kannada: ದೊಡ್ಡ ಕನಸು ಕಾಣಿ, ನಂತರ ಅದನ್ನು ನಿಜವಾಗಿಸಿ.
phrases.transliteration: Doḍḍa kanasu kāṇi, nantara adannu nijavāgisi.

phrases.english: Peace is a choice, choose it.
